Based on current 2026 reviews, here are the best CRM options for small businesses: ## Top Overall Options HubSpot is the best CRM for most small businesses thanks to a genuinely useful free tier with unlimited contacts, deal tracking, and email integration, plus paid plans starting around $15–20 per user per month. It's widely regarded as the top free option and particularly strong for businesses building content-rich strategies, with seamless website and email integrations. ## Budget-Friendly Alternatives Zoho CRM is the best budget pick at roughly $14/user/month with a free plan for up to 3 users, while Pipedrive suits small teams that just want simple pipeline tracking without a lot of setup overhead. Bigin (Zoho's streamlined sibling) earned PCMag's 2026 Editors' Choice for small businesses due to flexible dashboards, omni-channel support, and low cost scaling ($9/user). ## Specialized Options Insightly is a combined CRM and project management platform for small businesses that need to manage both the sale and the delivery of the work. ## Key Features to Look For When choosing a CRM, consider: the right CRM should grow with you, starting at a price point that makes sense for your current team size, with plans that scale reasonably as you add seats and capabilities , and the best CRMs connect effortlessly with the tools a small business already uses every day, including accounting software, standard email clients, and calendar applications.
